blocks.title: Volumetric analysis, indicator aur end point
blocks.text: Volumetric analysis titration se solutions ki concentrations maloom karta hai: anjaan concentration ka solution standard solution ke maloom hajm (volume) ke saath aahista aur ehtiyat se milaya jata hai jab tak rang ki tabdeeli reaction ke mukammal hone ka pata na de. Woh madda jo apne rang ki tabdeeli se reaction ke mukammal hone ka pata deta hai indicator hai, aur jis lamhe indicator rang badalta hai woh end point hai. Koi bhi solution burette mein liya ja sakta hai, doosra conical ya titration flask mein.

Phenolphthalein solution ek gram indicator ko 500 cm3 50% ethanol mein dal kar banaya jata hai; titrate kiye jane wale 10 cm3 solution mein sirf ek se do qatre istemal hote hain. pH kam hone par is ka rang gulabi (pink) se be-rang ho jata hai. End point batane wala halka gulabi rang aahista aahista phika parta hai kyunke hawa ki carbon dioxide dheere dheere solution mein hal hoti hai.
Saman: burette, pipette, funnel, conical flask, HCl solution, NaOH solution, phenolphthalein.

items: Pipette ko pehle distilled water se aur phir diye gaye NaOH solution se dhoyein (rinse karein).
Conical flask ko sirf distilled water se dhoyein.
NaOH solution ka 10 cm3 pipette se conical flask mein dalein.
Phenolphthalein ke ek se do qatre dalein; solution gulabi ho jata hai.
Burette ko pehle distilled water se aur phir diye gaye HCl solution se dhoyein.
Burette ko clamp stand par seedha lagayein.
Ise funnel se HCl solution se bharein, phir funnel hata dein.
Pende ki tap se thora acid beaker mein bahne dein taake nozzle ka koi hawa ka bulbula nikal jaye.
Anti-parallax card ya safed kaghaz istemal karte hue burette reading ko ibtidai (initial) reading ke taur par note karein.
Indicator ki rang tabdeeli saaf dekhne ko conical flask burette ke neeche safed kaghaz par rakhein; dekhein ke burette se risao (leak) na ho.
Burette se acid qatra qatra flask mein dal kar rough titration karein.
Acid dalte waqt achhi tarah milane ko flask ke mawad ko ghumate (swirl) rahein.

Acid tab tak dalte rahein jab tak solution ka gulabi rang ghayab ho kar woh mustaqil be-rang na ho jaye: end point. Burette reading ko aakhri (final) reading ke taur par note karein; final mein se initial reading nikal kar istemal hue acid ka hajm milta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke step xiii mein likha hai ke acid tab tak dalein jab tak rang 'light pink persistently' ho jaye. Yahan NaOH flask mein hai aur phenolphthalein ki wajah se shuru se gulabi hai; acid dalne se end point par gulabi rang ghayab ho kar solution be-rang (colourless) ho jata hai. Is liye sahi: acid tab tak dalein jab tak gulabi rang bilkul ghayab na ho jaye aur solution be-rang rahe. Kitab ka 'Did you know' bhi kehta hai ke pH girne par rang gulabi se be-rang hota hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch marahil: pipette se NaOH solution conical flask mein; dropper se indicator dalne par solution gulabi (pink); burette mein acid, initial reading aur tap band (Hold); tap khol kar (Release) acid ke qatre gulabi solution mein; final reading, tap band, aur flask ka solution be-rang.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.6: Titration ka tareeqa (kitab ki Figure 16.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein pipette par 'Acid solution' likha hai aur aakhir mein flask gulabi ho jata hai, yani acid flask mein aur base burette mein. Magar kitab ka apna tareeqa NaOH ko pipette se flask mein aur HCl ko burette mein rakhta hai. Is surat mein phenolphthalein dalte hi NaOH gulabi ho jata hai aur end point par gulabi rang ghayab ho jata hai (gulabi se be-rang, jaisa kitab ka 'Did you know' kehta hai). Hum ne tareeqe ke mutabiq sahih tasveer banayi hai: pipette mein NaOH, flask gulabi, aur aakhri flask be-rang.

Sahih aur ek doosre se milti (concordant) readings ke liye titration dohrayein: kam az kam teen concordant readings jo aapas mein 0.1 cm3 ke andar milti hon. Mushahidat rough, 1, 2, 3 ke taur par table mein likhe jate hain, final reading x, initial reading y aur istemal hue acid ka hajm (x - y), jis se istemal hue HCl solution ka hajm cm3 mein milta hai.

blocks.caption: Mushahidat (istemal hue HCl solution ka hajm = ________ cm3)

blocks.title: Molarity equation
blocks.text: M1 V1 / n1 = M2 V2 / n2, jahan M1, V1 aur n1 acid ki molarity, istemal hua hajm aur balanced equation mein moles ki tadaad hain, aur M2, V2 aur n2 base ke liye wahi. Diye gaye base solution ki molarity M2 = M1 V1 n2 / (n1 V2) hai.

blocks.prompt: Indicator aur end point ki tareef karein, batayein ke concordant reading kya hai, aur wazeh karein ke flask sirf pani se kyun dhoya jata hai (Quick Check 16.2a, b; MCQ I, II; exercise Q.2d).
blocks.explanation: Indicator woh madda hai jis ki rang tabdeeli dikhati hai ke reaction mukammal hai; end point woh lamha hai jab indicator rang badalta hai. Concordant readings dohrai gayi titration ke woh hajm hain jo aapas mein 0.1 cm3 ke andar milte hain. Flask sirf pani se is liye dhoya jata hai ke dhone se bacha koi NaOH pipette kiye 10 cm3 mein jama ho jata aur acid ka hajm zyada aata; pipette aur burette is ke baraks un solutions se dhoye jate hain jo un mein liye jate hain taake bacha pani unhen patla na kare.

items: Titration: anjaan solution standard solution ke muqable end point tak jo indicator dikhata hai (phenolphthalein pH girne par gulabi se be-rang; CO2 halne se phika).

Tareeqa: pipette (pani phir NaOH) se 10 cm3 NaOH + 1 se 2 qatre indicator sirf pani se dhoye flask mein; burette (pani phir HCl), funnel hataya, bulbula nikala, anti-parallax card se initial reading; safed kaghaz; ghumana; rough phir teen concordant readings 0.1 cm3 ke andar.
NaOH + HCl -> NaCl + H2O; M1 V1 / n1 = M2 V2 / n2 base ki molarity deti hai.
